title: Magical Water Bucket for nether
description: Adds Recipe that Allows you to Craft special Water Bucket that Works in the Nether
body:
This datapack adds crafting recipe for Custom Item witch looks and behaves exectly like Watter bucket with one key diference: it can be used in nether to place water

Becose this datapack creates a way to get water in nether it can effect the balance of the game and, if used correctly, can provide a way for players to skip some intended game limits.

So... For that reason careful considoration is advised before adding this to public servers

If you have some experiance with creating datapacks you can change crafting recipe to make it easyer or harder to obtain it. also, advancement detection can be changed so that any water bucket works in nether (in that case remove recipe since it is not needed)

removing this datapack from the world will not leave any storeges, scoreboards, bossbars etc. behind, but items that were already crafted will stay as unique/unobtainable items
